title: DAIS Lab member
description: One member of the Decentralised AI Systems (DAIS) Lab. One file per person, named firstname-lastname.json.

_how_to_fill.description: Instructions for the person filling in the file. Ignored by the website.

name.description: Full name as it should appear on the website, e.g. "Joana Tirana".

preferred_name.description: Optional short or preferred name, e.g. "Yuxuan".

role.description: Role in the lab. For alumni, the role they held.

status.description: "current" while in the lab, "alumni" after leaving.

end_year.description: Year they left; null while current.

research_topic.description: One short line, shown on their card, e.g. "Split and federated learning at the edge".

bio.description: Two or three sentences about their research, written in the third person.

email.description: Contact email, e.g. a UCD address. Leave empty to hide.

photo.description: File name of their photo in assets/people/, e.g. "joana-tirana.jpg". Leave empty to show initials.

funding.description: Scholarship or grant, if any, e.g. a research centre or fellowship.

thesis_title.description: PhD or MSc thesis title, once known.

selected_publications.description: Up to three papers to highlight. Keep titles exactly as published.

now_at.description: Alumni only: where they went next, e.g. "Research Scientist, Company X".

show_on_website.description: Set to false to keep the file without listing the person publicly.
